# YT AutoLike

> Privacy-first Manifest V3 browser extension (Chrome, Chromium, Edge, Firefox) that automatically likes YouTube videos and Shorts after a configurable watch threshold. No telemetry, no remote code, no hidden network calls. Built with React, TypeScript, and Extension.js; Node.js 24 and pnpm 11.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Vijay431/yt-autolike/blob/main/README.md): features, install, usage
- [Contributing](https://github.com/Vijay431/yt-autolike/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, verification gates, PR rules
- [Developer guide](https://github.com/Vijay431/yt-autolike/blob/main/release/DEVELOPER.md): build, package, and release workflow
- [Privacy policy](https://github.com/Vijay431/yt-autolike/blob/main/PRIVACY_POLICY.md): data handling and permissions
- [Security policy](https://github.com/Vijay431/yt-autolike/blob/main/SECURITY.md): vulnerability reporting
- [Changelog](https://github.com/Vijay431/yt-autolike/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history
- [Project site](https://vijay431.github.io/yt-autolike/): landing page, multilingual

## Source

- [src/manifest.json](https://github.com/Vijay431/yt-autolike/blob/main/src/manifest.json): permissions and entry points
- [src/content/engine.ts](https://github.com/Vijay431/yt-autolike/blob/main/src/content/engine.ts): watch-time tracking and auto-like decision logic
- [src/background.ts](https://github.com/Vijay431/yt-autolike/blob/main/src/background.ts): service worker, messaging, storage orchestration
- [src/popup/PopupApp.tsx](https://github.com/Vijay431/yt-autolike/blob/main/src/popup/PopupApp.tsx): popup UI
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Vijay431/yt-autolike/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions and repo map for AI coding agents
